summary: chore(settings): remove leftover PageMfaGuardTest debug route
description:
## Because

- The route `/settings/mfa_guard/test/auth_client` was registered statically and without a gate, so the debug page shipped in the production bundle.
- The page rendered the signed-in user's own MFA JWT and session token cache key into the DOM.
- The component was MfaGuard proof-of-concept scaffolding. Its own comment said it was temporary.

## This pull request

- Deletes `PageMfaGuardTest/index.tsx`.
- Removes the import and the `<Route>` for that page from `Settings/index.tsx`.
- Removes the debug entry from the `guardedRoutes` list in `Settings/index.test.tsx`.
- Points the README MfaGuard examples at real pages, `PagePasskeyAdd` and `Page2faChange`.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: FXA-14216
